summary: Full backend test matrix for the 5 new features (GST eligible-sales math, GST liability/payment lifecycle, Owner Reports visibility gate, PIB preview modal endpoint, and Perth 10% rate) — 13/13 pytest cases passed on live preview URL. Covered: /api/gst/recompute (idempotent), /api/gst/liabilities (filters + totals), /api/gst/mark-paid (M+1 day-20 expense creation), /api/gst/unmark-paid (reversal), /api/owner-reports/set-visibility (admin-only RBAC), /api/owner-reports/visibility-status, /api/owner-reports/monthly-report (gated for owner, unlocked post-flag, admin sees always), /api/center-accounts/preview-pib (summary payload, no disk write). Frontend smoke test was partially blocked — login page requires center-dropdown selection that the automation couldn't cleanly drive, so UI render verification of Owner Reports page + PIB preview dialog could not be completed end-to-end by the testing agent. Source-level inspection confirms all required data-testids are present in OwnerReports.jsx (owner-reports-page, or-center-select, or-year-select, or-month-select, or-load-btn, or-gated-banner, or-kpi-cards) and should be in CenterAccounts.jsx (pib-preview-dialog/content/download/cancel per main-agent file refs).
action_items: Main agent to self-verify the 2 UI flows in-browser: (a) Owner Reports page loads with filters + KPIs for SA + shows gated banner for franchise owner on a not-ready month; (b) Center Accounts PIB Preview dialog opens with content and a working Download button before any PDF is written.
Consider adding a small test to assert /api/gst/mark-paid refuses when amount==0 (currently 400); already covered implicitly by the mark-paid flow selecting amount>0 liabilities.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/owner_reports.py gracefully returns {success:true, visibility:{ready:false,reason:...}} to non-admin owners without leaking sales/gst — matches spec.
utils/gst.py.compute_gst_from_rows uses max(0, total - aggregators) for eligible_base — prevents negative GST when aggregator sales exceed total (e.g., bad data).
center_accounts.py summary endpoint also uses the eligible-base formula (line 1499) — parity with owner-reports is good.
Backend /api/gst/recompute is NOT role-gated — any authenticated user can trigger. Consider restricting to admin+ to avoid franchise owners forcing recomputes.
OwnerReports.jsx auto-loads on center/year/month change (useEffect on line 67) in addition to the Load button — harmless but results in extra network calls.
